measured_result.description: Use analysis.json and next-target.json for exact means and ratios; rounded prose is descriptive.

Ten checked negative origins are scanned without a plan attempt. The existing whole-plan route requires a completed checked negative origin.

requirements: Census actual checked conditional leaves before claiming they survive or improve coverage.

Classify native proof kinds. The existing partial extractor only handles empty, unit, split and component rules; unsupported endpoints, including implication certificates, remain open until a checked source-bound transport is provided.

decision.policy: Keep lazy binary closure experimental. It improves the eager gate but remains slower than handoff-only with identical completed-root coverage; no production default changes.
decision.secondary_target: If binary recognition is revisited, census checked current-subset model reuse before rebuilding SCC graphs; a binary witness never certifies the full CNF.

limitations: Previous 126/150 holdout is exposed. Fresh 132/156, seed 202611240406: 72 queries, 48 distinct roots, six families. Freeze before fresh evaluation; no outcome filtering.
Four alternating serial repetitions compare handoff-only, eager binary closure and lazy binary closure; all use 2 MiB pending-handoff capacity and start empty with native dispatch cap 256.
Only source CNFs enter search. Parent-archive novelty supplies no answers. A native dispatch budget is not a bound on discovery, compiled certificates, checking, memory or total work.

Reuse exact complete UP on a canonical cofactor. With forced assignments, inspect raw restricted binary clauses first. Normalize and serialize the full residual only on a binary contradiction; rerun canonical SCC for identical preceding certificate bytes.

Duplicate removal and an injective variable renaming preserve binary satisfiability. Already-canonical probes use the original gate directly. Binary SAT, uniform models and incomplete unit closure confer no full-CNF authority.

Misses avoid full normalization/key preparation, but raw duplicates increase graph work and hits pay a second SCC pass. Recognition, reconstruction, proof checking and native publication remain charged.

Worker timers include setup, restriction, normalization, SCC, verification, fallback, publication, serialization, persistence, retained state, warm/cold replay, reconstruction and compression; imports, source hashing, case loading, final bookkeeping and historical audit are separate.

Canonical reconstruction should retain identical naive/lazy certificates, branch choices, models, dispatch counts, retained payload and coverage. This is a checked invariant, not an assumption excusing validation.
Preserve regressions, unknowns and earlier authoritative payloads. No default change, broader tractability or uniform polynomial bound on arbitrary SAT is inferred.

Every preceding authority payload is unchanged; raw trials retain alternative proofs. All six naive/lazy table payloads and complete result contents except counters and timings are identical; controls may retain different proofs.
Both native readers audit every retained node and all 342 preceding partition records. Per-query ID chronology is checked for four tables; full replay checks all six.

All 353 preceding census cofactors reproduce the exact complete UP binding, binary decisions and canonical certificates. The initial test-only error querying absent lazy-created legacy tables remains preserved.
Historical audit, census re-evaluation and tests are outside serial matched timings. This is not a polynomial guarantee, a lower-bound result or proof of expanded structural coverage.
Posthoc selection chooses the largest fresh mean lazy-minus-current solve change; this is not another holdout or a policy gate.
Each arm replays its own exact empty-start prefix and matches every status, metric and retained payload to the timed worker.
Profiling overhead and concurrent verification are outside matched means. Cumulative function costs overlap; call counts and ordinary matched timings remain separate evidence.
Naive/lazy certificate identity does not imply improved coverage over handoff-only or lower total cost. Both controls and all regressions remain explicit.
All 64 preceding proof environments are unchanged. The full suite retains pre-existing SQLite ResourceWarnings.
